fields.Name: T189 - Roles System-Role Edit Protection
fields.Description: Exercises the isSystemRole() gating that disables Edit/Delete on protected roles plus the role-card expand — governance logic unique to RoleManagement.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, open 'Identity & Access', and select the 'Roles' sub-section. The list shows role cards, each with a type badge (System vs Custom) and Edit / Delete action buttons. Verify that for system roles the Edit and Delete buttons are disabled (not actionable), while custom roles have them enabled. Also expand a role card to confirm it reveals a stats section and a 'Permissions Preview' note. Success is observing the system-role action buttons being disabled and a card expanding. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Roles list renders role cards with System/Custom type badges and Edit / Delete buttons
Edit and Delete are disabled for system roles (and enabled for custom roles when present)
Expanding a role card reveals a stats section and a 'Permissions Preview' note
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
